_comment: Operator-owned policy. A capability can read its manifest but never this
file, because a capability that can edit its own permissions is not a
Three lists per tier, and the most restrictive statement wins: deny beats
require_human beats allow. A permission matched by none of them is DENIED.
Patterns are kind:resource. `*` is one path segment, `**` spans segments,
and a kind with no resource is written without a colon, e.g. proc.spawn.
default_tier applies to any manifest that declares no trust of its own.
